class.name: DampedSpring2D
class.brief_description: A damped spring that smooths a [Vector2] value toward a target.

method.name: update
method.description: Advances the spring's internal [member velocity] by [param delta] seconds and returns the new value, moving [param value] toward [param target_value] according to [param parameters]'s [member DampedSpringParameters.time] and [member DampedSpringParameters.damping]. Call this once per frame (or physics tick), passing in the value returned by the previous call as [param value]. If [param parameters] is [code]null[/code], [member velocity] is left unchanged and [param value] is returned as-is.

members.member: The spring's current rate of change, advanced in place by [method update]. Usually left for [method update] to manage; can be read or set directly to inspect the spring's momentum, reset it, or give it an initial velocity.
